carry_index_methodology.calendar_day_policy: carry is compounded once per elapsed calendar day on an internal daily grid, then sampled on joint USD/MXN and UDI observation dates
carry_index_methodology.level_observation_policy: USD/MXN and UDI levels are never forward-filled; retain dates where both levels were observed
carry_index_methodology.missing_rate_policy: use the last published annualized rate after the first valid observation
carry_index_methodology.scope_limit: synthetic classroom indexes; not observed prices, total-return indexes, or investable strategies
carry_index_methodology.stored_interval_formula: I_t / I_s = product from d=s+1 to t of (1 + (y_(d-1) / 100) / 360)

tiie_28d.note: Banco de Mexico changed the 28-day TIIE methodology from submitted bank quotes to a market-transaction-based method. The synthetic carry path preserves, rather than removes, this break.

module_1_analysis_window.note: Module 1 slices wider source snapshots to this requested window; actual boundaries follow each source calendar and frequency.

notes: CSV snapshots are committed for reproducible publication builds.
Banxico and DB.NOMICS source rates are percentage points; macro rates are decimals.
Carry compounds the previous known rate once per calendar day under a 360-day convention.
NASDAQ adjusted closes come from Yahoo Finance through yfinance for classroom EDA.
Snapshot provenance does not itself establish redistribution or downstream-use rights.

observation_policies.nasdaq_stock_panel: provider trading dates; no forward filling
observation_policies.official_macro_panel: monthly last observations; no forward filling
observation_policies.official_price_panel: observed USD/MXN and UDI intersection plus derived carry indexes
